subject: Trouble loading package for app hosted on spark

messages.author: 75100463b7eff618
messages.subject: Trouble loading package for app hosted on spark
parts:
Hi
I have a little app which is hosted on the Shiny server .
It requires a package called JPEG. When I run this on my machine, it all works fine.
But when I run it over the web (from spark), it does not work and I get an error that says:
"package ‘jpeg’ was built for i386-w64-mingw32"

I realise that my method of building the app is probably out of date - i.e. I am not using shinyapps.io
Instead I connect to my spot on the shiny server using FileZilla and drag the library for the packages I need into the R library folder.

Is there a better/different way of loading required packages?
Thanks
Andrew

messages.author: 75100463b7eff618
messages.subject: Re: Trouble loading package for app hosted on spark
parts: Nevermind - I have started to use the Shinyapps.io and it is all good. I guess the problem was the version of R on spark is out of date now.
